description: Every Extron spec sheet and user manual, browsable and searchable offline with revision tracking no other Extron tool has.

novel_features.name: Revision drift check
novel_features.description: See which downloaded spec sheets and manuals have a newer revision available upstream, so project shares never run stale docs.

novel_features.name: Doc-set completeness
novel_features.description: Per-model gap report across Brochure, Declaration of Conformity, Design Guide, Product Guide, Manual, and Revit BIM — see which doc types each model is missing.

novel_features.name: Library what's-new
novel_features.description: Newest Extron literature across the whole library, ordered by date, filterable by category and age.

novel_features.name: BOM doc bundle
novel_features.description: Assemble the full official doc set for every model in a rack bill of materials — report or batch-download in one pass.

novel_features.name: Series grouping
novel_features.description: Browse every document for a product family (DTP, MAV, IPL, DVS, ...) across all alphabetical letters at once.

novel_features.name: Download integrity
novel_features.description: Compare local PDF sizes against the download ledger to flag truncated or mismatched downloads.
